title: Research on the mechanism of P and F in phosphogypsum stabilized by humic acid synergized with group metallic triad-based curing agent
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19702-19717
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01271J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kezhen Chen, Jiangtao Shang, Yingying Cai, Qiong Hu, Heng Li, Xiong Tong
To address environmental risks from high soluble P and F in phosphogypsum, a green low-cost stabilization strategy using humic acid synergized with inorganic curing agents is proposed.
